title: THE 23:30 MESSAGE
summary: 高級ホテルの立入制限フロアで男性が死亡した。だが死亡後のはずの23:30、彼自身の声によるメッセージが届く。
question: How could the victim send the 23:30 message if he was already dead, and who is using that contradiction to hide the true timeline?
dramaticIntent: The dead man apparently speaks at 23:30.
ALPHA appears suspicious because he controls the records.
ALPHA is exposed as having altered a record, creating a false solution.
ALPHA's secret explains the alteration but not the death.
GAMMA's illicit access creates another plausible but incomplete route.
The player realizes delivery time is not recording time.
BETA's knowledge contradicts his stated timeline.
The player must accuse the person positioned as the safest ally.
mechanicalObligations: Only an explicit finish command completes a play
editorialObligations: Affection changes the experience of suspicion
